info.name: OAN Registries - Fully Parameterized Integration
info.description:
One executable New Dev intake workflow for Farmer, Crop Sown and Livestock. Select one of the three environments and supply an authorized staff login only in local values. Each run discovers the live intake form, all related field definitions, code lists and hierarchy; generates coherent synthetic data; saves every supported section; reads every field back; finalizes to ordinary approval; and reads every tab. No manually entered record IDs or JSON are required. One iteration creates one synthetic submission. No approvals or direct database writes are included.

Coverage means writable/API-supported fields, not generated lifecycle/aggregate identifiers. Three Farmer consent datetime fields are excluded because the deployed native route does not convert JSON datetime strings. Synthetic consent rows carry PENDING status and a clearly invalid test signature, not real granted consent. Crop Sown defaults to the Planning intake; later lifecycle forms may require approved prerequisite records. Dummy image references reuse the generated test document configured in the Farmer environment. Credentials, tokens and private verification IDs are absent from shared artifacts.

Optional record_image_document_id fields in Crop Sown and Livestock are omitted in the default environments because their document-upload endpoints returned SYS-ERR-001. Set a valid catalog test_document_id to populate those references after upload is available. The Farmer test-image upload and photo/certificate references passed.
